computation.rotational_refinement: unrestricted SO(3) Kabsch after translation-only warmup
computation.scan_sampling: trimesh area-uniform triangle surface sampling, fixed scan seed, no visual/texture copy
computation.scan_loading: trimesh.load(force='mesh', process=False); no components or collision substitution
computation.observations: frame-0 independent object-mask pixels with positive finite calibrated stereo depth and stereo validity; no radial object crop
computation.stereo_grid: exact mask/depth shape and intrinsics allclose atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5 via existing loader
computation.primary_subsampling: uniform without replacement; min(4000, above-table count), seed 0
computation.stability_subsampling: three independent full searches, floor(0.75 * min(4000, above-table count)), seeds 1/2/3
computation.table: background labels == 0 within radius of mean independent object points; RANSAC normal hint from MoGe, SVD refit; plane n dot p = offset
computation.table_normal_orientation: sign aligned with normalized MoGe normal hint
computation.initialization: observed mean + 0.02 m horizontal camera-back displacement; scan sample horizontal mean aligned, minimum sample height on table
computation.loss: mean of sorted distances[:max(1, round(0.8 * n))], in metres
computation.best: argmin final trimmed observed-to-model loss; no labels
computation.ambiguity: any final rotation strictly >30 degrees from best with loss <= 1.05 * best loss declines
computation.stability: any fixed subsample best strictly >10 degrees from primary best declines
computation.missing: decline missing visual scan, independent mask/stereo support, <300 above-table points, or failed stereo table fit; producer integrity mismatches raise
computation.basin_display: greedy loss-ranked representatives with <=30-degree geodesic assignment; decline compares ALL final rotations
computation.pair_errors: b = R0.T @ (t1-t0), C = R0.T @ R1, compared in full 3D against mocap; no symmetry quotient
computation.label_order: whole requested prediction report completed before separate errors operation
